name: @swordfate/pi-manager
description: Independent Pi Manager distribution extracted from the Pi Web Hub and Gate sources

scripts.build: npm run typecheck && vite build --config vite.config.ts && node scripts/manager-dist.mjs --write
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run verify:dist
scripts.test: npm run build && npm run test:offline
scripts.test:offline: npm run test:package && npm run test:unit && npm run test:gate:offline && npm run test:runtime:offline
scripts.test:runtime:offline: PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 PYTHONPATH=runtime python3 -m unittest discover -s runtime/tests -p 'test_*.py'
